title: seemps_galerkin: code and data for "A Tensor-Network Chebyshev-Galerkin Method for Boundary-Value Problems in Computational Mechanics"
description:
Code and data accompanying A Tensor-Network Chebyshev-Galerkin Method for Boundary-Value Problems in Computational Mechanics (J. J. Rodríguez-Aldavero, Á. de la Rosa Velasco, J. J. García-Ripoll).

The seemps_galerkin package implements a quantized tensor-train (QTT) Chebyshev-Galerkin method on top of SeeMPS, together with dense Chebyshev-Galerkin and QTT finite-difference references. The repository contains the package and its test suite, five tutorial notebooks, the notebooks for the four numerical experiments of the paper and the conditioning study of its appendix, and the stored results and figures used in the paper.
